authority: user_sample_size_design_instruction; substantive RQ and hypotheses unchanged

inference.fixed_demand_scope: solver and hardware variability conditional on one frozen demand instance
inference.across_demand_scope: conditional synthetic Ota location-sampling population with fixed audited candidate pool, fixed regional quotas and common static road model

primary.scenario_reason: retain TOC_DELIVERY_SPEC.md existing main case; S1 is engineering qualification, not an automatic change of scientific primary case
primary.estimand: E[D_D-D_C | both methods obtain accepted plans] under the registered demand/seed law; feasibility always co-reported
primary.power_kind: research planning convention; not measured or guaranteed power

secondary.CI_kind: 95 percent pointwise exploratory; not simultaneous confidence for all comparisons
secondary.promotion_rule: new pre-main protocol with an enumerated family and Holm FWER control; do not promote after main outcomes

precision.zero_mean_relative_precision_fallback: require a predeclared absolute halfwidth; do not divide by zero

pilot.initial_counts_kind: initial variance-design assumptions, not main sample sizes and not a universal sufficiency claim
pilot.rationale: 11 between-family and 24 within-family degrees of freedom in a complete balanced random-intercept model; uncertainty must be retained
pilot.fixed_v1_instance_role: separate engineering sentinel only; never a random population draw
pilot.quantum_off_control: paired auxiliary D control; not an independent fourth method or replicate
pilot.one_A_rule_per_instance: A2_angle0_with_common_completion; canonical predeclared seed and budget
pilot.expansion_stop: pre-pilot approved resource cap; no stopping on a favorable effect or successful seed

variance.model: Delta_ij=mu+b_i+e_ij, independent families, conditionally independent repetitions, finite variance
variance.point_estimation: balanced ANOVA audit and nonnegative REML; use predeclared heteroscedastic or ratio-influence model where required
variance.uncertainty: joint upper variance envelope; chi-square mean-square envelope only under complete normal balanced model, otherwise calibrated profile/cluster procedure
variance.failure_handling: ratio of instance-averaged joint-success contrast numerator to joint-success probability; never complete-case nr treated as independent

sample_size.finite_sample_refinement: iterate t critical values; validate actual test coverage/power and failure process using pilot model before freeze2
sample_size.r_candidates: positive integers bounded by approved resource cap; no default five
sample_size.selection: smallest total cost design satisfying all registered precision, primary power, feasibility and analysis validity gates under variance uncertainty

feasibility.success: accepted plan passes common and independent validation, epsilon, measured T budget, and standard output completeness
feasibility.independent_Wilson_unit: predeclared repetition 0, one Bernoulli outcome per independent family per method/cell
feasibility.all_repetitions_CI: whole-family cluster procedure; do not use Wilson with nr as independent observations
feasibility.all_failed_or_all_succeeded: retain nondegenerate Wilson interval from independent family outcomes
feasibility.failure_metrics: D/W/verified-plan T stay null; attempt wall and reason remain recorded

randomness.generator: NumPy SeedSequence with explicitly constructed PCG64; pin installed versions before execution
randomness.quantum_training_and_final_current_scope: one PCG64 stream consumed in sequence; not separately independent training/final streams

inference_methods.primary_mean: instance-level Fieller ratio confidence set and zero-mean numerator test; complete-data paired t special case
inference_methods.descriptive_CI: whole independent families resampled with every method/repetition/condition retained; never also naively resample inner runs
inference_methods.median: median of registered conditional run distribution, not median of instance means; cluster resampling
inference_methods.resampling_numerical_calibration: freeze with pilot; separate computational Monte Carlo error from experimental n/r
inference_methods.model_branch_freeze: before main; do not select a favorable main p-value
inference_methods.serial_or_crossed_batch_effects: require a calibrated crossed demand/batch model or multiway resampling before main
inference_methods.undefined_bootstrap_draws: record; do not silently redraw or omit; CI remains HOLD if not identified

pareto.set_unit: method by instance by predeclared portfolio repetition over the same epsilon/budget grid
pareto.primary_uncertainty_display: pointwise empirical attainment probability with whole-family resampling; fixed-time slices

resources.scenario_formula: sum_cells n_s*sum_methods r_scm*c_scm + n_s*c_A + controls + setup/export/validation and common preparation
resources.solver_core_policy: equal one-core affinity and recorded effective thread settings; no method concurrency during timed trials

figures.content: D/W/T overall distributions, medians and actual n/r; A human T separate
D mean/difference 95 percent CI and effect size
W mean/difference 95 percent CI and effect size
T_program distribution and 95 percent CI; A T_human separate
S1 observed 3-objective front and attainment uncertainty

S3 observed 3-objective front and attainment uncertainty
